visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with glasses and a blue-checked apron holds a clear rectangular container of cooked brown rice toward the camera, smiling warmly in a bright, modern kitchen. (2) Close-up shots show her hands washing grains in a bowl, placing the rice into a stainless steel vacuum container, and later pouring soaked rice into a mesh sieve to drain. (3) Inside a white cast iron pot, olive oil is drizzled, followed by the addition of the drained rice and clear water measured from a plastic cup. (4) She adds a pinch of salt by hand and cuts a small piece of dark kelp with scissors into the pot before placing the white lid on top and adjusting it on an induction burner. (5) The camera captures her finger pressing the digital touch interface of the black stove, which lights up with blue and white indicators. (6) A blue oven mitt is used to lift the lid, revealing steaming, fluffy brown rice which she stirs with a textured white plastic paddle. (7) Finally, she tastes a small bite of the rice and then wraps a portion in a piece of black dried seaweed, eating it and giving a double thumbs up to the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 分享幾個小訣竅. [Slogan]: 煮出好吃糙米飯. [Variety]: 維持腸道健康 人不老！. (2) [Subtitle]: 很多人想知道，用鑄鐵鍋怎麼煮出好吃的糙米飯. (3) [Subtitle]: 前一天先將糙米洗乾淨 放在冰箱冷藏浸泡. 大約泡12~16小時 讓糙米吸飽水分. (4) [Subtitle]: 把浸泡糙米的水倒掉. 瀝乾水分、先放一旁. (5) [Subtitle]: 重新測量水量. 小訣竅一：煮糙米飯加15ml的清酒 (可以去除糙米的澀味). (6) [Subtitle]: 鑄鐵鍋裡 加入一點橄欖油. 把米倒進來. (7) [Subtitle]: 糙米的水量為1:1.4. 小訣竅二：加一小攝鹽 可以帶出穀物自然甜味. (8) [Subtitle]: 小訣竅三：加一小塊昆布 米飯會更好吃喔！ 煮白飯也可以加昆布 米飯會更好吃！. (9) [Subtitle]: 蓋上鍋蓋. 鑄鐵電子鍋小技巧：鍋身往後推一下，記號對準中間. (10) [Subtitle]: 鍋蓋部分 往前推一下，可避免噗鍋 (讓蒸氣孔順利排出). (11) [Subtitle]: 機器按下電源兩次 選擇糙米行程 選擇兩杯米量 按下OK 按下開始！. (12) [Subtitle]: 鑄鐵鍋煮糙米小技巧：選擇2杯米的行程 可以讓糙米煮更久些 口感更柔軟！. (13) [Subtitle]: 蓋子有蓋好，全程不溢鍋！. (14) [Subtitle]: 煮糙米的行程 大約需要一小時. (15) [Subtitle]: 開蓋的小技巧：往外掀開，直接讓水往鍋內滴 (可避免滴到機身). (16) [Subtitle]: 鍋蓋立在鍋架即可. 先把昆布夾起來. (17) [Subtitle]: 看到飯上面產生的螃蟹洞嗎？ 這就是好吃的象徵喔！. (18) [Subtitle]: 輕輕的鬆一下飯. 這樣煮的糙米，每一口都鬆軟喔！ 吃起來 粒粒分明卻不乾硬！. (19) [Variety]: 馬上就想吃一口 😋. [Subtitle]: 嗯～好好吃 有糙米自然的甜味. (20) [Subtitle]: 直接包海苔吃 也好好吃喔！. [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, middle-pitched female voice speaking in Traditional Chinese over a light, up-tempo acoustic guitar and piano BGM. The voice is clear and welcoming, with an inviting instructional tone. (2) A splash sound occurs as water is poured into rice, followed by the crisp, percussive rustling of grains being drained in a sieve. The BGM maintains a steady beat under the speech. (3) Distinct digital 'beeps' signify the interaction with a stove's UI, layered over the muffled thuds of a pot being positioned on a hard surface. (4) A hollow metallic click is heard when the lid is closed, and later, a satisfying 'whoosh' of steam and a wet scraping sound follow as the rice is fluffed. (5) The speaker emits an appreciative 'Mm~' vocalization after tasting, followed by the faint crackle of dry seaweed being handled. The BGM continues smoothly throughout with no pauses. (6) The session ends with a final energetic speech segment and a slight volume swell of the music before a hard cut to silence.
